definitions.gloss: every single word; word for word
definitions.explanation: Each and every word of something said or written, emphasizing that nothing is missed or changed.

examples.japanese: {一言一句|いちごんいっく}{聞|き}き{漏|も}らさない。
examples.english: To not miss a single word.

examples.japanese: ⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{一言一句|いちごんいっく}⟦メモした→メモする：25501_memosuru⟧。
examples.english: I wrote down every single word the teacher said.

examples.japanese: ⟦{契約書|けいやくしょ}→契約書：06416_keiyakusho⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{一言一句|いちごんいっく}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{丁寧|ていねい}→丁寧：00896_teinei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}して→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{署名|しょめい}する→署名する：22432_shomeisuru⟧べきだ。
examples.english: You should check a contract down to the last word before signing it.

notes:
A four-character compound (⟦{四字熟語|よじじゅくご}→四字熟語：15663_yojijukugo⟧): {一言|いちごん} (one word) + {一句|いっく} (one phrase).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {一言一句|いちごんいっく}{違|たが}わず: word for word, without a single difference
- {一言一句|いちごんいっく}{聞|き}き{漏|も}らさない: to catch every word
- {一言一句|いちごんいっく}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧: down to the last word

PRONUNCIATION:
Read いちごん, not ひとこと: いちごんいっく.
